scope: Completed additional GPU validation round: selected native workflows pass; shared NVMe optimizer-restore and FSDP1 empty-shard boundary failures remain explicit. This is not a proof of all APIs, models or backend combinations.
reference_use: Original Accelerate was executed in isolated processes as a black-box reference; its source and tests were not read for these workflows.
evidence_lookup: Paths are relative to this report. Run artifacts are collected beneath gpu-extended/extended-20261101; each run preserves its own source snapshot and module origins.

environment.dependency_isolation: DeepSpeed 0.18.2 and 0.19.9 use separate prefixes; the original gpu-env and system packages were not modified. CPUAdam was compiled against real CUDA libraries, using a separate linker-alias prefix.

comparison_contract: A successful checkpoint write is not a successful restore. Full-flow comparisons require successful save and fresh-process resume on both implementations.
Full-tensor comparisons cover model checkpoint/final weights and recorded losses/LR. They do not independently compare every optimizer tensor, scalar metadata or RNG byte.
Cross-implementation exact equality (rtol=atol=0) and within-implementation BF16 replay tolerances are recorded separately.
TP/CP cross-implementation JSON weight summaries are not full-tensor equivalence. Their independent dense-oracle checks and observation differences are reported explicitly.
Cases, phases and ranks overlap; counts must not be summed into a number of independent supported features.

multinode_core.checked: Entire numerical comparison payload: training, accumulation, metrics, checkpoint continuation and export.
multinode_core.failed_case: Original fsdp1_bf16 fixture fails optimizer restoration on both implementations; retained separately below.

multinode_deepspeed.checked: Full checkpoint/final model tensors, all recorded losses and learning rates; fresh-process save/resume both pass.

cases.tp: Node-local TP2 x cross-node DP_shard4/FSDP; full dense update checks and checkpoint continuation within each implementation.
cases.cp: CP8 causal Flash Attention forward/backward, full dense update checks, replica equality and input-buffer restoration; no CP checkpoint case.

observed_differences: Distributed type string FSDP versus DistributedType.FSDP.
CP profiler records one extra candidate c10d::_allgather_base_ dispatch (2 versus 1).
multinode_parallel.boundary: Exported cross-implementation weights are JSON summaries, not complete tensor bytes; all-to-all execution does not prove RDMA or cross-rack transport.

transformer_engine_fp8.checked: Real TE CUDA FP8 kernels and finite gradients, AdamW/StepLR training, full checkpoint/final model weights, recorded losses/LR and fresh-process continuation.
transformer_engine_fp8.historical_boundary: The first report also retains missing MXFP8 reference results; the later MXFP8-specific report supplies its successful rerun. These are separate results, not an all-pass claim for the earlier job.

external_scheduler.name: Torch StepLR
external_scheduler.reference_resume: failed LR after optimizer conversion/load; scheduler retains old optimizer
external_scheduler.candidate_fix: Rebind scheduler.optimizer to converted CPUAdam before engine setup.
external_scheduler.boundary: This path is not an all-variants parity pass; original failure evidence is retained.

cpu_offload.native_execution: Compiled DeepSpeedCPUAdam, actual CUDA training and CPU optimizer/master-parameter partitions; no emulated optimizer.

passed: Real CUDA training and CPUAdam updates.
Actual local NVMe parameter and optimizer swap files.
Training and checkpoint saving on both variants.
Fresh-process restoration of every full model tensor with zero error on both variants.
Save-phase checkpoint/final full model tensors and recorded losses/LR match across implementations exactly.
nvme_offload.failed: Optimizer parameter-group learning rate does not restore on either variant; expected checkpoint LR 0.0025. The actual loaded LR was not directly recorded.
unverified: Post-restore continuation: blocked by the strict LR precondition before another training batch.
Other non-tensor optimizer metadata, including Adam step count, was not directly observed after load.
nvme_offload.prior_boundary: An earlier 1Mi-element subgroup configuration also lost the non-swappable small bias tail during load. The later fully swappable group is a diagnostic control, not proof that all subgroup layouts restore.
nvme_offload.diagnosis: The tested DeepSpeed NVMe restore copies swap tensor files while skipping ordinary ZeRO optimizer-state metadata loading. No LR assertion was bypassed, no tolerance enlarged, and no checkpoint files manually copied.

ulysses.model: Official Transformers random Llama: 2 layers, hidden128, intermediate256, 8 attention and KV heads, vocab256, sequence128.
ulysses.checked: Real SDPA/Flash Attention training, all-to-all communication, finite nonzero gradients, reconstructed input shards, complete model checkpoint/final weights and all recorded loss/LR.
ulysses.oracle: First dense/sharded forward both use SDPA MATH; parameters are BF16 and corresponding rotary buffers are FP32 with identical values. Training then uses real Flash Attention. Oracle tolerance was not loosened.
ulysses.candidate_fix: Initialize the public DeepSpeed distributed backend before Ulysses registration.
ulysses.dependency_boundary: DeepSpeed 0.18.2 trains and saves but fails fresh SP checkpoint loading on both variants. Official released 0.19.9 fixes checkpoint model-parallel rank selection; this is a separately pinned environment, not a local checkpoint patch.

pretrained_qwen.checked: Complete initial/trained/continued model-state tensor byte hashes, recorded losses/LR, top-8 inference IDs/logits and one exact restored continuation step.
limits: Optimizer/RNG state were not independently fully hashed; their tested behavior is supported by the observed model/loss/LR continuation.
One ordered run per variant with repeated fixed text; not a quality, convergence, long-context, scaling or statistical speedup result.

Allocated and reserved are per-process PyTorch allocator peaks after warmup, not total GPU use. Resetting peaks does not empty caches; reserved peaks include blocks retained from initial full-state hashing and warmup. These are not isolated steady-state memory requirements.
Single and eight-rank timings use different global batches, step counts and contexts; do not infer scaling efficiency or memory-reduction ratios.

fsdp1_boundary.finding: At world size eight the original four-row output layer produces empty local optimizer shards. Actual GPU diagnostics show complete original param_groups and metadata, then the native PyTorch DCP planner changes to a legacy aggregate key and fails restoration.
fsdp1_boundary.boundary: The unchanged four-rank model and wider eight-rank control pass; neither repairs nor replaces the original eight-rank failure. Runtime and acceptance tolerances were unchanged for these controls.

megatron.parallelism: TP2 x PP2 x DP2 with sequence parallelism
checked: Complete initial/checkpoint/final model parameter tensors and all recorded native outputs, losses and learning rates.
Both variants restore in fresh processes on every rank; restored model and native continuation output errors are zero.
Exact public CausalLMOutputWithCrossAttentions type, loss field, keys and logits=None for default GPT return_dict=True.
Consumed samples restore at 8 and finish at 16; actual engine iterations and optimizer/scheduler observations agree.
Real pipeline groups [0,4], [1,5], [2,6], [3,7] cross two hosts; all ranks record send and recv. TP/DP groups stay node-local.
megatron.input_contract: Tokens, labels and positions compare with original shape/value exactly. Only boolean causal attention masks use legal broadcasting before exact value comparison; original shapes [2,1,32,32] and [1,1,32,32] are retained.
megatron.hf_label_contract: Black-box probes of labels=input_ids, arbitrary labels and -100 values established that the default HF GPT pretraining bridge derives next-token targets plus EOS from input_ids. The candidate now reproduces this. Custom/native-label paths retain their separate behavior and are not claimed fully verified.
megatron.earlier_single_node_scope: Candidate TP2+SP, TP2xPP2+SP and TP2xDP2+SP completed native training and fresh restoration; final cross-implementation acceptance uses the two-node configuration above.
megatron.provider_scope: Common public custom native GPT provider with official tokenizer rebuilding, 4 layers/hidden128, BPE vocabulary257 padded by native Megatron to512. Default model providers, BERT/T5, return_logits and every custom training mode are not covered.
observation_differences: Raw args.iteration and RerunStateMachine state differ despite matching functional results.
Global CUDA RNG/config observations are retained; no claim that every internal RNG or optimizer byte is identical.

topology_scope.boundary: Actual distinct Slurm hosts/local GPU slots are audited. Hosts share an NVL prefix; no claim of cross-rack network or RDMA transport.

historical_failures_retained: CPUAdam development linker aliases were missing in the ARM monolithic Torch wheel; a separate prefix points to real CUDA libraries with source/SONAME/hash provenance.
External Torch scheduler still referenced the optimizer replaced by CPUAdam; candidate binding corrected and fresh resume rerun, original failure retained.
DeepSpeed 0.17.6 NVMe checkpoint copytree race, 0.18.2 small unswappable tail loss and optimizer LR metadata restoration failure remain recorded.
DeepSpeed 0.18.2 Ulysses checkpoint rank mapping failure is retained alongside successful official 0.19.9 results.

Ulysses first-forward BF16 kernel mismatch and native rotary-buffer precision mismatch were corrected in the shared fixture by aligning kernels and buffer dtypes, without widening acceptance tolerances.
Original eight-rank FSDP1 empty-shard optimizer restoration failure remains a failed case despite passing diagnostic controls.

Megatron label and public-return mismatches are retained and rejected by the final comparator. Explicit matching expert-TP configuration resolved missing reference checkpoint shards; no checkpoint file was fabricated or copied to bypass restoration.
remaining_unverified: Megatron default native model provider, BERT/T5, return_logits, alternate return_dict/custom batch modes, MoE and all native dataset/ramp-up combinations.
Complete NVMe optimizer-state restore and post-restore continuation; all subgroup layouts.
All FSDP1 empty-shard checkpoint layouts and PyTorch versions.
Combined FSDP+TP+CP+SP topologies, cross-node Ulysses, and all model/attention/optimizer configurations.
Multi-node TE FP8, all scaling recipes and FSDP float8 all-gather.
TPU/XLA, other accelerator vendors, cloud submissions and most online tracking services.
General throughput, convergence, model quality, long-context behavior and performance or memory improvement claims.
